scope.guards: All frozen dataset form/number/term/noun-role/alignment/name/compound/mask guards unchanged. Corpus evidence is not live-user role proof.

methods.default: Exact prior component-weighted target-face frequency; all prior explicit predictions must match
methods.narrow: left bigram, right bigram, centered trigram; pinned MAX_NGRAMS=2 range(1,2)
methods.wide: Every contiguous 2–8 native-token window containing exact focus, including noncentral positions
methods.punctuation: Any token without alphabetic character is a barrier, never skipped. Unknown/multiunit/ambiguous lemma is a barrier in lemma channel only.

learning.weight: Each source key/component total mass1; divide by independent source-focus rows and by retained target faces of row; same prior default
learning.pattern_admission: Unique maximum target, differs from default, >=2 independent supporting components, winner weighted count >1.5*default contextual count +1e-12
learning.ties: Context target tie within1e-12 abstains; frequency tie lexicographic
learning.absent_default: Permitted with >=2 supporting components; infinite ratio for rule ordering. Explicit adaptation: pinned upstream initializes absent default probability1, which suppresses such rules. No claim of verbatim upstream execution.
learning.single_target_keys: No contextual rule possible; retain defaults/training IDs but skip redundant pattern materialization
adaptations: Target exact supported faces rather than bilingual lemmas
Component/source-occurrence weights instead of raw translation repetitions
JSON lookup table rather than LRX binary
Wider2–8 arm extends pinned adjacent/centered recipe

lookup.backoff: Next shorter eligible rule then exact frequency default; unseen key unavailable

review.sample: up to8 changed plus4 unchanged controls, hash(source-focus ID) ordering one per component; controls only if any eligible changed; no quota backfill

bounds.basis: Only30 multi-target keys generate context rules; at most70windows/source row (2channels*sum2..8), max209090 training windows before barriers/dedup. Retain compact shared evidence, reject before output cap, no truncation. Production fresh free288GB/25GBavailableRAM.
